name: chrome-devtools-mcp
description: Reliable Chrome automation, debugging, and performance analysis for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Automate, debug, and profile Chrome with DevTools for agents
interface.longDescription: Chrome DevTools MCP gives coding agents reliable browser automation, in-depth debugging, and performance analysis through Chrome DevTools and Puppeteer. Install this plugin to register the chrome-devtools MCP server and the bundled skills under ./skills so agents can navigate pages, inspect the DOM, capture traces, and diagnose real browser issues.
capabilities: MCP tools and agent skills for Chrome DevTools
defaultPrompt: Open the app in Chrome and take a snapshot of the page
Debug why this page is slow using Chrome DevTools performance tools
Check this page for accessibility issues
